author: Andrew Fisher

findings.detail: Unknown ordered quantity is assumed one in Inventory, while map quantity stays unknown. No current active live line has unknown quantity.

checks.name: Every active typed inventory and map quantity matches the shared charge-line scope
Cancelled and moved references are excluded from inventory quantities
Seven-category index averages dimensionless percentages, not metres plus pieces
Quantity edit reaches reference charge lines and map immediately
Quantity edit reaches Today reference and category denominator
Quantity edit reaches Inventory and Demob scope
Quantity edit reaches supplier outstanding run sheet
Two received of six stays a partial receipt, not six installed
Partial receipt reaches Inventory and supplier outstanding quantity
Partial receipt does not mark today delivery or final completion complete
Full receipt fulfills delivery while installation remains incomplete
Confirmed completion reaches Today, map and supplier installed count once
Completed receipt leaves no supplier delivery balance
Removing physical completion removes map check and Today completion
Typed partial collection reduces current stock and remaining pickup quantity
Partial collection does not imply completed Demob
Supplier current stock follows same typed collection
Every in-memory fixture restored the exact original shared record

testRevisionNote: Evidence from first successful audit run; ownership assertion was subsequently added to make the independently observed mismatch fail future regressions.
